fields.title: 📖 Yūsuf’s Brothers Defended Themselves before a Foreign System
fields.body:
🖋️ **Yūsuf’s brothers and al-Bukhārī** said:

> ***“By Allah, you know well: we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we are not thieves.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Mere defense against an accusation is not automatically Kufr or Shirk. It is not the same as worship, nor as legitimizing a foreign legal system.

immutable.source: 📝 Qurʾān, Yūsuf 12:58, 12:73, 12:76; al-Bukhārī, Khalq Afʿāl al-ʿIbād, Geschichte vom Juden und Muslim vor einem Muʿaṭṭil.
